department: School of Computing and Information (Computer Science PhD)

app_fee.value: USD 85 for all School of Computing and Information graduate programs.
app_fee.quote: There is an application fee of $85 for all SCI graduate programs.

fee_waiver.value: Only currently enrolled Pitt students, or applicants who attend a full SCI information session (one waiver), get a fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: Currently enrolled Pitt students are eligible for an application fee waiver.

also.quote: an application fee waiver is offered to those who attend a master’s or PhD information session with SCI

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for admission to this program.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is optional for admission to this program.

english_waiver.value: The test is waived only for degrees from the U.S. or a country whose official language is English; India is not named, so confirm with the school. The Dietrich School country list does not apply to SCI.

also.quote: Computer Science programs: The test will be waived if the applicant has or will have a bachelor’s or master’s degree from the U.S. or a country whose official language is English.

funding.value: At the doctoral level, financial assistance is often offered through a graduate assistantship and sometimes a fellowship; no guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: At the doctoral level, financial assistance is often offered through a graduate assistantship, and sometimes through a fellowship.

deadline.value: January 5, 2027 for Fall 2027 (the school's financial-aid cut-off for other programs is January 15).

entry_route.value: Students may be admitted to the PhD without an MS degree.
entry_route.quote: Students may be admitted to the PhD program even if they do not have an MS degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Minimum English scores for the CS PhD: TOEFL 90 or 4.5 (new scale) with at least 22 or 4.0 in each section, IELTS 7.0, Duolingo 130.
